uncited: It builds on [SVO Node Encoding](2705-svo-node-encoding.md) by extending the concept of compact node descriptors to support variable refinement levels inherent to AMR simulations.
*   **Internal Nodes:** Encode existence and location of children.
Bit $i$ is 1 if the $i$-th child exists, 0 otherwise.
*   **Bits 8-62 (55 bits):** Offset to children in the array.
**Encode Internal Nodes:** For each internal node, determine which of the 8 potential children exist.
Set the corresponding bits in the 8-bit child mask.
Calculate the offset to the first child in the contiguous array.
**Encode Leaf Nodes:** For each leaf node, pack the single-precision data value into the descriptor.
**Store Value Ranges:** For every node (internal and leaf), store the min/max value range in the separate 64-bit range array.
*   **Refinement Assumption:** The method assumes a refinement factor of two.
A 32-bit integer encoding used for octree nodes.
The most significant bit (MSB) distinguishes between leaf nodes and internal nodes (addresses). [Link](2705-svo-node-encoding.md)
Handles the serialization of SVO data into blocks. [Link](2741-block-writer-for-svo-serialization.md)
Maps the sparse voxel octree mask to a compact representation. [Link](5103-svo-mask-mapping.md)
*   **Memory Complexity:** Each node uses 64 bits for the descriptor and 64 bits for the value range, totaling 128 bits per node.
*   **Strengths:** Preserves AMR hierarchy, enabling faster and higher quality rendering than flattening to unstructured or rectilinear grids.
